sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panic and self-reproach, worried that starting the term late has already ruined her chance to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: I was defeated by... basic clothing maintenance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and mildly flustered, but is trying to soften the mishap with quiet self-deprecating humor rather than show real frustration.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels stunned and quietly exasperated, as if the morning’s absurd string of mishaps has left her too tired to do anything but stare in disbelief.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly exasperated but still oddly composed, shifting from disbelief to determined problem-solving with a faint, resigned sense of humor.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and mortified, with a sinking sense of guilt as she apologizes immediately and tries to shrink out of the way.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief spike of panic as the hot croquette burns her, but she’s still trying to stay quiet and composed despite the chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you... and I'm really sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and flustered, but is trying to stay polite and composed while quietly grateful for the help.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I don't deserve a reward for this.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and self-reproachful, quietly insisting on her own fault even while being touched by the owner’s kindness.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is too stunned and exhausted to speak, feeling a mix of mortified disbelief and fragile resignation after one absurd mishap after another.
sprite_sequence.label: serious_expressionless

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly devastated and absurdly sympathetic, feeling a small, helpless grief for the croquette as if even her one bit of comfort had been cruelly denied.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.text: If even breakfast gave up... maybe I can stop panicking for one second.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and absurdly defeated, but a tiny, helpless humor is letting her breathe and regain a sliver of composure.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Oh. Right. That would have been worse.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, weary relief mixed with lingering embarrassment, realizing with a small jolt that her near-disaster could have been even more troublesome.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and chastened, but also quietly relieved to have been stopped before making things even worse, so she answers meekly and obediently.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and self-conscious about how obvious her frazzled, unlucky morning has been, but tries to answer quietly and politely without making a fuss.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and relieved, with a faint, embarrassed sense of triumph after barely surviving the morning’s chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Please let the disasters stay outside the school today.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted but quietly hopeful, trying to steady herself with a small, anxious wish that the day will finally become normal once she gets inside.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
